text:
maya: Heads-up — noticed ACME-prod missing 03:00 aggregates in the dashboard. Late events arrived but the recompute only picked up up to 02:59. Looks like a tiny late batch (~2k events) but recompute would touch a shard and could spike slot usage. any quick plan?
sam: oof. can you paste the job id / shard?
maya: job id: replay-2026-03-19-acme-03, shard s42. raw events: s3://telemetry/late/2026/03/19/03/*. Small window.
li: if it's that small we can run a targeted recompute with slice-size=500 and max-concurrency=2; should keep slot pressure low. Need console toggle to pin priority lane so it doesn't queue behind big backfills.
chris: agree. also enable kv-prefetch on the recompute worker to avoid cold kv misses — that reduced token work last month.
eva: quota question — who owns the priority lane for tonight? we have a preallocated burst for SEV ops but last time the burst got consumed by a bigger replay.
maya: @eva good call. can we temporarily bump ACME tenant priority for this run? only for 10m. I'm happy to coordinate the rollback.
ops-bot: Alert: replay-2026-03-19-acme-03 created at 1749999965. Current queue position: 14. Estimated run time (default): 18m.
sam: if we do targeted recompute, console needs a quick UX toggle — "allow small-batch fastpath" — that sets priority=manual-burst and prefetch=true. I can push the flag but need approvals.
li: command we usually use: 
```
redwood replay run --job replay-2026-03-19-acme-03 \
  --slice-size 500 --max-concurrency 2 \
  --priority manual-burst --kv-prefetch true \
  --tag ops:late-hotfix
```
Run this from the ops shell.
chris: also add --dry-run first with --limit 1 slice to validate ordering/ids.
eva: ok i'm granting the manual-burst for tenant acme-prod for 10 minutes. please annotate the run in the console (tag: "emergency-late-hour").
maya: executing dry-run now, will post result in 60s.
ops-bot: Dry-run result: 1 slice validated, no ordering conflicts, estimated real run cost = 0.03 slot-minutes.
maya: launching full targeted run. LMK if any errors.
sam: monitor console: route traffic away from the affected aggregate endpoint for the duration, then flush prefix cache once recompute completes.
chris: i can watch logs and prefetch metrics — ping me if KV miss rate spikes.
maya: run finished: status=SUCCESS, recomputed hour 03:00 for acme-prod, delta +120 events, dashboard refreshed. rolling back priority and untagging. :tada:
eva: thanks team. let's add a tiny UX improvement for fastpath toggle in the console next sprint — make it a one-click with audit note.
li: raising a tiny RFC for an explicit small-batch run mode that pre-applies kv-prefetch + soft-priority. will link to the run details.
maya: handoff complete, thanks all.
